# AgentCost First Reply Template

Thanks for the context. To see whether AgentCost can help, I only need three things first:

1. What AI workflows are running today? Examples: support classification, report drafting, coding agents, internal search.
2. What do you currently pay or estimate per month for AI usage?
3. Which business unit should costs be tied to first: customer, feature, plan, model, session, or agent run?

Please do not send raw prompts or personal data at this stage. We can start with anonymized usage metadata and provider export totals.
